problem_summary.summary: Normalize an absolute Unix-style path by resolving current and parent directory markers and redundant separators.
problem_summary.input_output: Input: an absolute path string. Return its canonical form with one leading slash, single separators, and no trailing slash except at root.
constraints: path contains English letters, digits, periods, slashes, and underscores
The input is a valid absolute path

brute_force.explanation: Split on slashes, ignore empty and '.' components, pop one stored directory for '..' when possible, and append ordinary names to the canonical result with immutable string concatenation.
brute_force.correctness_idea: Each ordinary component adds one directory level, '.' changes nothing, and '..' removes the most recent level if one exists. Ignoring empty components collapses repeated separators; joining the remaining names yields canonical form.
brute_force.time_complexity: O(n^2) worst case due to repeatedly copying the growing output string, where n is path.length.
brute_force.space_complexity: O(n) for split components, stored directories, and intermediate strings.

optimized.explanation: Scan path components by index without creating a split array. Keep surviving directory names in a deque and build the canonical path once with StringBuilder.
optimized.correctness_idea: The component rules are identical to path resolution: ignore empty and current-directory parts, pop for parent-directory parts without crossing root, and retain all other names including names such as '...'. Joining retained components with one slash enforces canonical formatting.
optimized.time_complexity: O(n); each path character is scanned a constant number of times and written at most once.
optimized.space_complexity: O(n) for the retained directory components and returned path.

steps.event: Read component b after repeated slashes
steps.condition: Repeated separators create no components; b is ordinary.
Parent marker and stack is nonempty.
... is an ordinary name; . means current directory.
steps.action: Push ... and ignore the single dot.

steps.condition: c is an ordinary name; trailing slash has no component.
steps.action: Append each name with exactly one leading separator.

edge_cases.handling: The deque is popped only when nonempty, so the result remains at root.
Empty components are ignored and output separators are reconstructed once.
Only exact '.' and '..' components have special meaning.
